server.name: code-mcp
server.instructions: Coding agent for this repository. Call system_info before writing your first shell command or path. Prefer the project commands over guessing build incantations, and ask git_diff for stat or name_only before a full patch.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build every package in the module.

commands.name: test
commands.description: Run the test suite. Pass args like "-run TestFoo ./pkg/..." to narrow it; defaults to the whole module.

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Vet and lint the code base.

commands.name: fmt
commands.description: Format all Go sources in place.
